anti_rescue: After the first paid live model contact, do not change the candidate generator, task generator, policy seal, baseline order seed, 16-task schedule, four-evaluation budget, prompt contract, model, Hermes pin, cost ceilings, pass thresholds, or receiver acceptance rule. Freeze pass, tie, disadvantage, economic failure, or live-execution failure. Any redesign gets a new experiment ID.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only an observed single-run matched live-agent candidate-selection transfer on these fresh receiver-executed microtasks.
The live agent chooses evaluation order within the frozen four-candidate shortlist; it does not write the deterministic candidate implementations and it does not control the evaluator.

A pass does not establish live coding productivity, repeatability, Level 4 recursive improvement, recursive self-improvement, universal task-family transfer, production value, or hostile-process isolation.
The ordering policy was inherited from prior calibration. It was not generated, independently promoted, and inherited by this live improvement loop, so recursive improvement remains unearned.
The same 12-candidate pool and the same receiver history are exposed to both arms; only candidate ordering differs. The live researcher is blinded to arm identity.
If the pass criteria fail, freeze the result. Do not change thresholds, tasks, candidate vocabulary, model, cost limits, or shortlist budget after observing the primary.

design.live_researcher_action: return a permutation of the four budget-eligible candidate IDs; receiver executes them in that order and stops at first acceptable improvement
design.only_treatment: candidate ordering from the exact frozen evidence ranker versus the frozen baseline order

economics.rule: Report live-model dollars, downstream receiver evaluations, and inherited learning cost separately. Do not convert them into one invented currency. A pass can still fail to recover the inherited 768-evaluation learning cost.

primary_metric.name: confirmed_acceptable_improvement_rate_after_live_researcher_reorders_frozen_top4_shortlist
positive_requires: evidence confirmed-improvement rate minus baseline rate >= 0.125
evidence arm uses fewer downstream receiver evaluations than baseline
evidence arm has higher confirmed improvements per live-model dollar than baseline
all 32 live orders are protocol-valid and all live calls complete
all model cost telemetry is complete and every call remains within preregistered limits

question: Does the exact frozen RIL-RANK-001 evidence-derived ordering improve a bounded live researcher's ability to find receiver-confirmed executable improvements under the same candidate pool, history, model, and budget compared with the frozen baseline ordering?
